name: What information do I need to get an accurate cabinet removal estimate?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to get an accurate cabinet removal estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before work starts, ask for clear photos or an in-person evaluation, because the crew needs to see cabinet type, countertop attachment, and any signs of water damage or previous repairs. In Denver-area homes, access details like parking, stairways, and narrow hallways also affect the estimate and scheduling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide photos or a walkthrough, plus details on cabinet condition, countertop attachment, and any water damage. Access information like stairs, parking, and narrow hallways also helps produce a more accurate estimate.
